welcome.title: Welcome to the admin console
welcome.body: A one-minute walk through where everything lives. The Guide button at the top brings it back any time.

menu.title: All sections
menu.body: Open the menu here. Sections are grouped by job: people and training, phishing, security operations, insights and settings.

training.title: People & training
training.body: Add people and departments, assign trainings, build learning paths and create new trainings in the studio.

phishing.title: Phishing simulations
phishing.body: Launch phishing campaigns and see who clicked, who reported it and who needs a refresher.

secops.title: Security operations
secops.body: Incidents, reported threats, intelligence and the sandbox. Click a group's title to fold it away; the console remembers.

insights.title: Insights
insights.body: Reports, the department league, the leadership view and the audit log of every change in the console.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Branding, email, sign-in rules and everything else about your organisation.

quick.title: Quick actions
quick.body: Everyday tasks in one click. With "Create training with AI" you describe a topic, AI drafts the training and you check it before anyone sees it.

setup.title: Setup checklist
setup.body: Finish these steps to get your organisation ready. Each one is ticked as soon as it is done.

guide.title: Replay any time
guide.body: This button starts the guide again whenever you want a refresher.

overview.title: Overview
overview.subtitle: Whole organisation

departments.title: Create departments
departments.body: Group people the way your organisation works.

people.title: Add people
people.body: Import a CSV file or add the first person.

email.title: Set up email
email.body: Connect your own mail server and send a test.

logo.title: Add your logo
logo.body: People see it in the app and in emails.

policy.title: Publish a policy
policy.body: Share your acceptable use policy for sign-off.

twofa.title: Require two-step verification
twofa.body: Protect admin accounts with a second step.

Campaigns aimed at it that have not started go back to drafts without an audience: choose a new audience for them. Results of campaigns that already ran are kept.

departments.cycle: A department can't be moved under itself.
departments.duplicate: A department with this name already exists. Choose another name or merge the two departments.

drill.title: Live drill
drill.subtitle: A phishing attack on your organisation, compressed into minutes, with the platform responding exactly as it would on a real working day.
drill.synthetic: Each person's reaction is simulated from their risk profile, and no email or SMS leaves the platform. Everything that follows is real: tracking, risk scores, threat reports, trainings and certificates are written exactly as in a live campaign.
drill.setupBody: Pick the lure, who receives it and how fast to play it back.
drill.audienceCount: {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} will receive it. You are left out: you are watching.
drill.speedHint: Either way it covers the first {hours, number} hours after delivery.

errors.empty: Nobody in this audience can receive it.
errors.feature: Live drills are not enabled for this organisation.
errors.rateLimited: Too many drills in the last hour. Try again later.
errors.unknown: The drill could not start. Try again.

drill.historyEmpty: No drills yet. The first one takes 90 seconds.

drill.peopleBody: One tile per person, grouped by department.

feed.click: {name} clicked the link. The teachable moment opened and “{module}” was assigned.
feed.submit: {name} typed a password into the fake page. Risk raised to high; only the fact is stored, never the password.
feed.report: {name} reported it. Matched to the simulation without an analyst, and XP for spotting it.

drill.raceBody: Attackers win when the first click comes long before the first report.
drill.riskBody: From each person's training, simulations and open risks (0 is best).
drill.summaryClicks: In {hours, number} simulated hours, {clicked} of {delivered} people clicked ({clickRate}), against an untrained baseline of {benchmark}.
drill.summaryReports: {reported} reported it; the first report came {minutes} min after delivery.
drill.summaryNoReports: Nobody reported it: the reporting habit is the gap to work on.
drill.summaryLoop: Every click got its training at once, and {trained} of {clicked} are already done. Average risk rose from {before} to {peak} with the clicks; reports and training brought it back to {now}.
drill.resilienceHint: Reports per click. Above 1, your people catch more than they miss.
drill.selLabel: AI Sel comments on the drill

sel.waiting: The message is on its way. Let's see who spots it.
sel.click: Someone clicked. I'm showing them what gave it away, and their training is already assigned.
sel.submit: A password went into the fake page. In real life that is an account takeover, so the risk is now high.
sel.report: A report! That's your human firewall at work.
sel.train: Training done, risk closed. The loop closes by itself.
sel.finished: Drill complete. Here is how your people did.
sel.cancelled: The campaign was cancelled, so the drill stopped here.

drill.summaryLoopFlat: Every click got its training at once, and {trained} of {clicked} are already done. Average risk moved from {before} to {now}.
